expect.description: the expect= the #test line gets: the run report's expectations.expect (violation | noViolation); null leaves the verdict

lines.description: the #expectViolation* lines to write; required ([] clears them)

index.description: the block's position in /api/cdt/parse's datasets (0-based); null addresses the first block of dataset.name — send it: a scenario may hold two blocks of one name

headerName.description: the header a mutating request sends the token in

paths.description: the uncommitted paths the user confirmed losing (status.uncommitted)

storeFormat.description: the open store's format version, -1 without a store

storeReason.description: why there is no store; empty when there is one

languageLevel.description: the branch's rules-src/LANGUAGE-LEVEL, null when it declares none

blob.description: the git blob id of the content; send it back on write

token.description: a personal access token of that login

pullRequestUrl.description: the forge's create-pull-request page for the branch

path.description: the rule's check path the run was asked for

anonymousRead.description: anonymous read access is served right now

defaultBranch.description: the repository's default branch; never writable

ignored.description: changes outside the editable trees (never staged)

uncommitted.description: saved, uncommitted changes under the editable trees

blob.description: the blob read; null when creating a file

info.description: The rule editor's REST API: log in with a forge token, work on a branch of the bound rule repository in a per-user git workspace, read and write rule files, commit, push, and search the corpus. Mutating requests carry the client's {branch, head, blob} and are refused with 409 STALE when the workspace moved on.
info.title: corej CDISC Rule Editor API

post.summary: Analyse a rule buffer: diagnostics, derived fields, scope universe, referenced variables (in-process, no execution)

get.summary: Local and remote branches; fetch=true refreshes (and prunes) from the remote first

post.summary: Create a branch from the remote default branch and switch to it (clean tree required)
Delete a local branch that holds nothing unpushed (a merged, pruned branch)
Check out a local or remote branch (clean tree required)
Fetch and merge the remote default branch into the current branch (clean tree; conflicts abort)
Fetch and merge the remote counterpart of the current branch (after a non-fast-forward push)
Replace the #expectViolation* lines of a scenario text with the confirmed ones and, with expect, set the #test line's expect= to the run's proposal (take actual as expected)
Parse a scenario text into its dataset blocks and prelude directives (the engine's own parser; cells in its field encoding)

Rewrite one dataset block of a scenario text from the grid, addressed by its index (else the first block of its name); everything else stays byte for byte (400 CDT_UNREPRESENTABLE with the engine's message)
Stage every saved change under the editable trees and commit it (hooks off)
Discard every saved, uncommitted change under the editable trees: restore tracked files from HEAD, delete new ones (the confirmed paths must be the current ones)

get.summary: A codelist of the metadata store's CT, by C-code or submission value, newest package first (tooltips); empty hits without a store
The rule language's functions: registry signatures joined with the branch's rule-guide/reference/functions.md help text
The branch's authored rule schema (rule-check.schema.json) for key and enum completion and key tooltips; 404 NO_SCHEMA when the branch carries none, 422 SCHEMA_INVALID when its file is not JSON
Families and their rules, with NEW / MODIFIED markers from git status
List one directory level under the editable trees
A file's content (UTF-8) with its blob id, branch and HEAD

put.summary: Save: write a file's content if the client's blob is still current

get.summary: Service name, build version and the bound repository

post.summary: Push the current branch, never forced; answers the create-pull-request link

get.summary: Rules related to one: a shared authority reference across families, the repository's equivalence / relation classes and minted parentage where it carries the registers (§5.5)

post.summary: Run one rule buffer against one scenario buffer in a child JVM worker: one run at a time per user or anonymous client (409 RUN_IN_PROGRESS), 503 RUN_BUSY beyond the queue, 503 WORKSPACE_BUSY when the workspace stays locked, 429 RATE_LIMITED for anonymous clients

get.summary: The scenarios of a rule's suite directory with what their prelude declares

Free text over check and docs YAML (words ANDed, quotes make a phrase), plus the semantic filters: mentions a variable (--X resolved through the scope), scoped to a domain / class, uses a function, status, standard + version, has no scenarios — all ANDed
The current session's identity and mode (401 without a session)
The CSRF token to send as X-CSRF-TOKEN on every mutating request, the login included; re-fetch after login and after logout

post.summary: Probe the forge with a personal access token and open a session; the token decides the mode (edit needs push rights AND a pushable token); 429 RATE_LIMITED beyond the per-client login limit; rotates the CSRF token
Drop the session and its token
